scope: Bounded recovery from 256 existing Smithsonian/Archive.org OCR candidates. This artifact adds separate recovery variants and does not change the existing candidates.

results.admissionRule: A named recipe and its full transcribed passage had to be found in a bounded line range of the retained, checksum-verified OCR text.

preservation.sourceInstructionText: Retained as an OCR transcription with source line range and source-document checksum.
preservation.ingredientStatements: Preserved as observed OCR notation; ambiguous fractions and measures remain unparsed. Ingredient boundaries normalize only surrounding whitespace; retained line-break hyphens are not dehyphenated.
preservation.sourceOptionality: Only the Cream of Tomato Soup parsley and celery additions are source-asserted optional, from the retained ‘If desired’ clause; all other optionality remains a candidate rather than an assumption.
preservation.planning: Every recovery record remains automaticPlanningEligible=false and requires personal culinary review.

validation.commonDataSchema: 5/5 packets passed Draft 2020-12 schema validation with IRI format checks, including a candidate derivedFrom relation to each existing core HistoricalRecipeCandidate resource.
validation.sourceBoundary: 5/5 declared title/boundary pairs were checked against the retained OCR text.
validation.nativeSchema: 5/5 records conform to the local recipe schema.
